nodes.name: tool-status-title.tsx
nodes.summary: Animates the transition between a tool call's active and done status titles, splitting the shared text prefix so only the differing tail swaps, with measured width transitions and shimmer styling.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a first-render/last-render width measurement around a requestAnimationFrame flip to animate the swap via an inline width style rather than CSS keyframes.

nodes.name: common
nodes.summary: Computes the longest shared prefix between the active and done status texts, returning the prefix plus the diverging active and done tails so only the differing tail animates.

nodes.name: ToolStatusTitle
nodes.summary: Renders the tool status label that cross-fades between active and done states, choosing between suffix-split mode and full swap mode, and animating width changes with requestAnimationFrame so the shimmer text doesn't jump.

nodes.name: tooltip.tsx
nodes.summary: Tooltip components wrapping Kobalte's tooltip with interaction suppression - tooltips stay closed while clicking, keyboard-activating, or when the trigger hosts an expanded popover tracked via MutationObserver.

nodes.name: TooltipKeybind
nodes.summary: Convenience wrapper that renders a Tooltip whose content pairs a title with a highlighted keyboard shortcut chip.

nodes.name: Tooltip
nodes.summary: Wraps Kobalte's tooltip with trigger-interaction state: arms a block on pointer-down or Enter/Space activation, suppresses re-open after trigger clicks, and stays closed while the trigger contains an expanded element observed for aria-expanded/data-expanded changes.

nodes.name: typewriter.tsx
nodes.summary: Typewriter effect component that reveals text with randomized per-character delays (with occasional long pauses) and a blinking cursor, rendered through a configurable dynamic element tag.

nodes.name: Typewriter
nodes.summary: Reveals text character by character with randomized keystroke delays, showing a blinking cursor that disappears two seconds after typing completes; all pending timeouts are cleared on cleanup.

nodes.name: data.tsx
nodes.summary: Defines the shared Data context exposing the SDK-backed store of sessions, messages, and parts (plus directory and session-navigation callbacks) consumed across UI components.

nodes.name: dialog.tsx
nodes.summary: Implements the modal dialog context: a single active Kobalte dialog rendered in a stack, with capture-phase Escape handling, a re-entrancy lock, a 100ms closing delay before root disposal, and owner-aware dialog creation.

nodes.name: init
nodes.summary: Builds the dialog context value: a single active-dialog signal with Escape-to-close capture listener, re-entrancy locking, and immediate disposal of any prior dialog when a new one is shown.

nodes.name: DialogProvider
nodes.summary: Provides the dialog context and renders the active dialog node inside a `dialog-stack` container beneath the children.

nodes.name: useDialog
nodes.summary: Consumes the dialog context, capturing the caller's SolidJS owner so dialogs render under the invoking component's reactive root and chain ownership when a dialog is already active.

nodes.name: file.tsx
nodes.summary: Tiny context allowing hosts to override which ValidComponent is used to render files in the UI.

nodes.name: helper.tsx
nodes.summary: Provides createSimpleContext, the factory every UI context uses to build typed provider/use pairs with optional readiness gating before children render.

nodes.name: createSimpleContext
nodes.summary: Factory that builds a typed provider/use context pair from an init function; gates children rendering on the context value's reactive `ready` flag and throws a named error when `use` runs outside a provider.

nodes.name: i18n.tsx
nodes.summary: Defines the UI i18n context with an English-dictionary fallback and `{{param}}` template interpolation, exposed through I18nProvider and useI18n; UiI18nKey is derived from the English dictionary's shape.

nodes.name: I18nProvider
nodes.summary: Provides the UiI18n value (locale accessor plus `t` translation function) to the component tree.

nodes.name: useI18n
nodes.summary: Returns the nearest UiI18n context, falling back to English-dictionary translation when no provider is mounted.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel re-exporting the context modules (helper, data, file, dialog, i18n).

nodes.name: marked.tsx
nodes.summary: Markdown rendering context: registers the custom OpenCode Shiki theme (CSS-variable syntax colors), wires marked with KaTeX math and Shiki highlighting extensions, and when a native parser is supplied post-processes its HTML with math rendering and code-block highlighting.
nodes.languageNotes: The OpenCode theme maps TextMate scopes to CSS custom properties (var(--syntax-*)) so highlighting follows runtime theme changes without re-instantiating Shiki; ~370 of the 519 lines are the theme registration.

nodes.name: renderMathInText
nodes.summary: Renders `$$...$$` display and `$...$` inline LaTeX in a text string to KaTeX HTML, falling back to the raw delimiter-wrapped text on render errors.

nodes.name: renderMathExpressions
nodes.summary: Applies math rendering to rendered HTML while leaving pre/code/kbd contents untouched by splitting on code-block boundaries and only processing the non-code parts.

nodes.name: highlightCodeBlocks
nodes.summary: Post-processes rendered markdown HTML by unescaping and re-highlighting each fenced code block through the shared Shiki highlighter with the OpenCode theme, lazily loading languages and defaulting unknown ones to plain text.

nodes.name: worker-pool.tsx
nodes.summary: Context providing the shared diff-rendering worker pools (unified and split) and a hook that selects the pool matching the requested diff style.

nodes.name: useWorkerPool
nodes.summary: Returns the diff WorkerPoolManager matching the requested diff style, choosing the split pool only for "split" and the unified pool otherwise.

nodes.name: custom-elements.d.ts
nodes.summary: Ambient JSX declaration registering the @pierre/diffs `<diffs-container>` custom element on SolidJS's IntrinsicElements so the web component typechecks in .tsx files.

nodes.name: create-auto-scroll.tsx
nodes.summary: Auto-scroll hook implementing bottom-follow behavior for streaming UIs: distinguishes programmatic scrolls from user scrolls via a timestamped mark, pauses on upward wheel or text selection, stays aware of nested scrollable regions, and manages overflow-anchor dynamically.
nodes.languageNotes: A `markAuto` timestamp+scrollTop snapshot lets the scroll handler recognize async-dispatched scroll events caused by its own scrollTo calls, preventing false user-scroll detection while content streams in.

nodes.name: createAutoScroll
nodes.summary: Keeps a scroll container pinned to the bottom while `working()` is true or content is settling: tracks user scrolls, ignores self-initiated scrolls, resumes following when the user returns near the bottom, and exposes ref setters plus scroll/pause/resume controls.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel re-exporting the hooks modules (use-filtered-list, create-auto-scroll).

nodes.name: use-filtered-list.tsx
nodes.summary: Fuzzy-filterable list hook combining fuzzysort search, Remeda grouping/sorting pipelines, and solid-list keyboard navigation for select-style dialogs; supports both static arrays and async filter functions.
nodes.languageNotes: Filtering runs inside a createResource so function-valued (async) item sources stay reactive with grouped output - replacing it with createMemo previously broke List-based dialogs; the flat/keys memos use manual pre-allocated loops to reduce GC pressure.

nodes.name: useFilteredList
nodes.summary: Builds a resource-backed list controller: filters items with fuzzysort (string arrays or keyed objects), groups and sorts the results, wires solid-list active-item tracking, and handles Enter-to-select plus ctrl+n/ctrl+p navigation while skipping macOS text-editing shortcuts.

nodes.name: en.ts
nodes.summary: English translation dictionary serving as the source of truth for all `ui.*` keys; UiI18nKey is derived from its shape and other locales fall back to these strings for untranslated keys.

nodes.name: ar.ts
nodes.summary: Arabic translation dictionary providing localized strings for the shared UI (`ui.*` keys), falling back to English for untranslated keys.

nodes.name: br.ts
nodes.summary: Brazilian Portuguese translation dictionary providing localized strings for the shared UI (`ui.*` keys), falling back to English for untranslated keys.

nodes.name: bs.ts
nodes.summary: Bosnian translation dictionary typed against the English dictionary's keys, providing localized strings for the shared UI with English fallback for untranslated keys.

nodes.summary: Danish translation dictionary providing localized strings for the shared UI (`ui.*` keys), falling back to English for untranslated keys.

nodes.summary: Japanese translation dictionary providing localized strings for the shared UI (`ui.*` keys), falling back to English for untranslated keys.
